name: Cushi
overview: The name Cushi appears in Scripture primarily as a faithful messenger who brought important news to King David during a critical moment, as seen in 2 Samuel 18:21-26 where Joab sends him to report on the outcome of battle. The watchman’s observation that a man running alone must carry tidings highlights Cushi’s role in conveying vital information promptly. Additionally, Cushi is noted as the father of Shelemiah and Zephaniah, indicating his presence within the genealogical records and the broader community context.
